purpose: Obtain an independent, non-authoritative DeepSeek opinion on every finalized visual-foundation vocabulary target and its complete visual pack before training.

live_capability_probe.probe_result: Correctly identified the canonical Errol smartphone/dragon image and its visible 9:41 text.

prerequisites: The finalized expanded lexicon has exactly one disposition per source concept and prerequisite concept.
There are no unresolved target-term collisions, personal-name placeholders, or unassigned reclaimed slots.

Every target has a non-empty canonical lexical label, an explicit locked teaching definition, and a valid part of speech; undefined words, placeholders, fragments without lexical meaning, and metadata-only labels are forbidden.
Every visual target has its required accepted assets; alternate representation routes have separate explicit dispositions.
The exact lexicon, asset manifest, hashes, captions, senses, and provenance are frozen for the audit.
A calibration suite containing known-good and deliberately defective packs has established acceptable reviewer behavior.

calibration.rule: Do not promote an experimental model to corpus-wide gatekeeper until its false-positive and false-negative behavior is measured.

request_unit.scope: one vocabulary target and its complete ten-image pack
required_context: representation contract and allowed visible text
request_unit.anti_bias_rule: Do not provide prior Luna verdicts or expected answers to the independent reviewer.

per_image_checks: Does the image visibly support the locked teaching sense rather than another sense of the word?
Is the intended evidence central and unambiguous without relying on hidden metadata?
Are visible words, numbers, equations, signs, and labels correct and appropriate?
Are there watermarks, broken geometry, malformed anatomy, impossible relations, or distracting generation artifacts?
Could a stable confounder teach the wrong association?
Is the image usable, age-appropriate, and compositionally clear at the training resolution?
per_target_lexical_checks: The canonical label is a real teachable lexical item, not an undefined token, placeholder, identifier, or metadata label.
The target has one explicit positive teaching definition stating what it means, not only what it is not.
The declared part of speech or lexical class is valid for the locked sense, such as noun, verb, adjective, adverb, or another explicitly defined lexical class.
Multiword lexical units are allowed only when the whole unit has one defined teachable sense and a declared lexical class.
A target that fails lexical definition or part-of-speech validation fails before its images can receive a PASS.
pack_checks: All ten assets teach the same locked sense.
The pack varies instances, settings, viewpoints, compositions, and representation style where appropriate.
No repeated incidental object, species, person type, text label, or background can become a shortcut for the word.
Pixel-identical and near-duplicate assets do not count as independent variation.
The pack contains enough direct evidence that its meaning does not depend solely on hindsight or captions.

escalation.rule: DeepSeek findings are independent information only, not authority to block training or mutate the corpus.
escalation.fail_or_uncertain: Record the exact finding for optional later inspection; do not create remediation work automatically.
escalation.reviewer_disagreement: Preserve the disagreement as evidence without changing the operator-authorized set.
escalation.mutation: This audit performs no mutation, replacement, generation, deletion, or automatic escalation.

training_gate.operator_authorization_precedence: The operator has authorized the frozen set; DeepSeek verdicts do not veto that decision.
protocol_complete_only_if: every target passes the no-undefined-words lexical gate
all finalized source and prerequisite concepts have unique dispositions
every finalized visual pack receives one preserved DeepSeek opinion
the audited manifest hash exactly matches the proposed training input
the final report states that verdicts are informational and non-authoritative
training_gate.failure_action: If coverage or hash binding is incomplete, report the audit protocol as incomplete; do not reinterpret model verdicts as training authority.
